messages.content: What is the historical significance of Al Fahidi Fort?

**Why Al Fahidi Fort matters in Dubai’s story**  

• Built in phases from coral rock and mortar, giving it a sturdy, traditional look.  
• Square‑shaped with towers on three corners—classic defensive design.  
• Served multiple roles: a palace for rulers, a garrison for troops, and even a prison.  
• Nearby you’ll see a replica of the old city walls and a tall dhow, echoing the fort’s historic setting.  
• In 1969 a royal letter asked Kuwait for a museum expert, paving the way for the fort to become Dubai Museum.  

So the fort isn’t just an old building—it’s a piece of Dubai’s defense, governance, and cultural preservation all wrapped into one.

Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood (Arabic: حي الفهيدي التاريخي; also known as Al Bastakiya) is a historic district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.


== History ==
The construction of Al Bastakiya dates back to the 1890s. In its prime, the locality was capable of 60 housing units, most of which were separated by narrow, winding lanes.
